edit.description: drive the factory's setup hook and its registry/script gate arms

summary: Pin harnessChain's setupWorktree branch and its registry/script gate arms — three factory decisions no case drives

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: tests/harnessChain.test.ts drives worktreeSetup on both branches and constructGate's registry and script arms through the real factory; every pins[] line is green.
pins: a declaration with no setup leaves every returned phase without a setupWorktree hook
a declared setup gives every returned phase a setupWorktree hook that provisions its worktree
each registry gate name the package ships constructs that builtin at the declared when
a registry gate name the package does not ship refuses the load naming the set it could have been
a declared script gate hangs the committed path at the declared when, named by the path
notes: harness/chain.ts:600 worktreeSetup, :465 registry, :486 constructGate. All three hold only in doc comments today: no test declares `setup` through harnessChain, and no test declares a gate of kind registry or script. registry()'s keys come off Function.name, set by Object.defineProperty in src/builtinGates.ts:153 — a cross-package derivation nothing pins.
